understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell only after adjusting the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required values. Completing all goals advances the level; winning requires clearing all levels before running out of lives/turn efficiency.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina; when stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum. If lives reach 0, the game ends (GAME_OVER). Movement is on a grid with walls; the state provides blocked_directions, and attempting any blocked direction wastes a turn/stamina without moving. Special modifier tiles change the carried piece when stepped on: shape-changer cycles shape IDs 0–5 (wrap), color-changer cycles colors in order orange → blue → green → red → orange (wrap), and rotation-changer rotates 90° clockwise (0° → 90° → 180° → 270° → 0°). A goal cell only activates when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously; stepping onto an activated goal completes it. Planning routes to reach needed modifiers and then the goal while avoiding blocked directions is essential to conserve stamina and lives.
